messages:
Ivy: Heads-up: our artifact-integrity alert flagged rwd-base:2026-03-19. Attestation metadata missing and sbom shows an unexpected ELF with writable+exec segments in layer sha256:fa11feed. Paging @Tom @Rhea for quick triage.

Tom: Oof. Can you paste the attestation and sbom snippets plus registry audit id?

Ivy: snippets: 
```
attestation: none found for manifest sha256:7f8e9a
sbom: package /usr/lib/libodd.so flags=writable,exec
registry-audit: gcr-audit-20260319-12
```

Rhea: Missing attestation + executable writable segment = high risk. oncall, please suspend pushes to registry.redwood/rwd-base and stop the scheduled garbage-collect. :rotating_light:

oncall: Pausing repository writes and GC job `registry/gc-weekly`. Kicking off canary rollback to rwd-base@sha256:2b3c4d (last attested) with 5% traffic. Job infra/canary-4299990001 created.

Tom: Check who can produce attestations (not just signatures). We use the attestor service account `attest-ci@ri.svc`. Also confirm KMS unwraps for our notary key `keyring/prod/notary`. If attestations are missing but image signed, we still treat as suspicious.

Ivy: IAM list: push writers = svc-builder, deploy-bot, attest-ci. attest-ci still has key unwrap role. Revoking attest-ci write to repo and removing its token from CI runners as immediate mitigation. Creating ticket TICKET-6291 and linking audit id.

kms-bot: KMS audit stub: notary-key unwrapped 1x in expected window; runner-temp-key unwrapped 6x across 3 distinct IPs outside corp net.

Rhea: That suggests an ephemeral runner or leaked token signed but didn't produce attestations. Possible pipeline misconfiguration. Tom, can you run a build-log grep for `cosign attest` vs `cosign sign` usage in the last 48h?

Tom: On it. Also add a temporary enforcement: CI job must run `cosign attest` step and push attestation to the referrers API. I'll open a PR to fail the pipeline when attest step is skipped.

Ivy: Forensics: create a blob diff between the attested image and current blob store. Use `skopeo inspect --raw` and `jq` on manifests. If layers differ, treat as tamper. I'll attach diffs to the ticket.

oncall: Canary rollback at 5% shows no immediate errors. Keeping GC paused. Will abort canary if error rate >1% or latency jumps.

Tom: KMS action: rotate runner-temp-key, revoke related service account tokens, and require short-lived tokens for ephemeral runners. I'll coordinate with infra to push rotation.

Rhea: Add detection rules: (1) alert when manifest lacks attestation referrer and has exec-writable segments, (2) alert on notary-key vs runner-key unwrap anomalies (outside corp IPs). Set sensitivity high for 72h.

Ivy: Also update the registry pre-push hook to reject pushes missing attestation OR missing SBOM. Short-term exception only via approved ticket. I'll draft the change.

Tom: One more: audit all recent artifact-retention/prune jobs for unexpected prune triggers in the last 7 days; ensure garbage-collect wasn't manipulated. If prune removed older attested digests, we need to recover from archive.

Rhea: Agreed. I'll pull GC job history and S3 archive logs. Linking results to TICKET-6291.

Ivy: Thanks. Will update when diffs and KMS rotation are complete. Notifying #secops and #platform. :white_check_mark:
